headline: A whale sinks the whaleship Essex
post_facts: A sperm whale rammed the Nantucket ship twice

scenes.text: [gravely] On this day, in eighteen twenty... a whale sank an American ship.

scenes.label: Whaling in the Pacific
scenes.caption: Painting by William H. Overend
scenes.title: Rammed by a sperm whale
scenes.text: [calmly] The Nantucket whaleship Essex was hunting in the Pacific, when a sperm whale rammed it... twice.

scenes.label: The Essex, November 20, 1820
scenes.caption: A sketch of the whale's attack
scenes.title: Twenty men in three small boats
scenes.text: [solemnly] Twenty men escaped in three small boats.

scenes.label: men survived the ordeal
scenes.text: [gravely] After months adrift at sea, only eight survived.

scenes.label: First mate Owen Chase
scenes.caption: He published the story in 1821
scenes.title: A survivor told the story
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] First mate Owen Chase wrote down their story.

scenes.title: It inspired Moby-Dick
scenes.text: [softly] Three decades later, it helped inspire Herman Melville's Moby-Dick.
